paragraphs: 如同 27 年前般，克里歐門王國歐倫市的王宮宴會廳正熱鬧地款待著冒險者們，不過此時坐在主桌的，是現任的女王，也就是當年的烏瑪公主。
龍之球在這二十多年內，已成功讓克里歐門王國產出了永續的電力，除了龍蛋上的紫色斑紋變得更淡之外，效力還是十分強烈。此時，龍蛋已被放在王國的博物館內，而這次女王聘請的冒險者們，任務是護送這顆蛋到指定的交易地點，與妖精的洛森王國進行交易，換取好幾箱妖精釀的美酒。
同樣的桌上，四名冒險者包含皮膚黝黑的猩猩獸人穆斯、喜愛彈奏與歌唱的漁人烏鯊大、把自己包得厚厚的、似乎非常怕冷的半妖精韓流，以及頭上有著四顆光球的闇妖精米亞拉。
在烏鯊大的烘托下，宴會非常熱鬧。米亞拉向烏瑪女王詢問關於一位名為泰坦妮亞的前輩，似乎過去也曾來這裡出任務，卻沒有了消息。女王簡單說明了自己所知的事：泰坦妮亞是過去前往取得龍之球的冒險團成員之一，但那些人只有一名狗頭人回來而已。
聽見了米亞拉對泰坦妮亞的打聽，一名矮人走向他，表示自己知道一些消息，要拉他到外頭談。烏鯊大和穆斯想跟著去，但在矮人的要求下被打發走了。走到王宮側門外，矮人遞給了米亞拉一根菸，將手搭在他的肩上，表示 27 年前，泰坦妮亞在離開前往出任務前，和他共度了一個美妙的夜晚。不過除此之外他沒有別的消息可以提供了。米亞拉陷入沉思，但同時，他看見了矮人的手伸向腰際一處，閃著金屬光澤。

矮人從腰際掏出一把匕首，對著米亞拉的肚子便是一陣猛刺。米亞拉一陣驚慌，趕緊掙脫，逃回王宮內，並透過自己的法術爭取了一些時間。米亞拉抱著肚子回到了宴會廳，引起了一陣騷動。烏瑪女王趕緊傳喚了醫師，肇事的矮人回到了宴會廳口後，在女王的譴責下，拿起剛剛刺殺米亞拉的匕首，劃破了自己的喉嚨，倒地不起。冒險者們檢查了矮人身上的狀況，發現那把匕首上似乎刻著妖精語，其中只有「純血」的字樣可以解讀而已。在其他矮人的說明下，這名矮人是名打鐵鋪的老闆，而這把武器看起來像是他自己鍛造的，不過對於他仇恨妖精的行為，沒有人有觀察到任何跡象。
烏瑪女王不斷向冒險者們賠不是，同時也答應讓韓流前往那名矮人的打鐵鋪探索一下。穆斯和烏鯊大則留下來陪伴受傷的米亞拉。在女王的安排下，烏鯊大和米亞拉同住一房，穆斯則先入住雙人房，等待韓流回來。
韓流和兩名矮人一同前往打鐵鋪的過程中，為了不讓一樣有妖精血脈的韓流感到不適，一名矮人表示自己的老婆也是妖精，另一名矮人則表示自己是同性戀，懂得身為少數族群的那種感受。到了打鐵鋪，眾人發現打鐵鋪的門已被敲破，裡面一片混亂，但是可以翻到不少和行兇的匕首相似的匕首，但看起來都是半成品。除此之外，並沒有多少收穫。
離開打鐵鋪後，在獲得同意下，韓流便前往老婆是妖精的矮人家過夜，另一名矮人也興致勃勃地一同前往。在妖精老婆的閱讀下，匕首上的文字沒有更多的解讀，但四人共度了美妙的一晚。
一早醒來，穆斯發現自己的室友還沒回來。復原完整的泰坦妮亞、在澡盆內睡得很好的烏鯊大，以及穆斯一同來到樓下宴會廳用早餐，並等待韓流回來。
用餐到一半，一名矮人女子來向他們打招呼，表示自己是本次和他們一同出任務的夥伴，但奇異的是，他不願透露自己的名字。
用完早餐後，女子抱著龍之球，與他們四人一同上了馬車，準備出發。女子向他們介紹，這次駕車的是一名機器人，叫啵啵C。
車上，女子從後車廂拿出了不少啤酒，讓烏鯊大和穆斯享用，韓流和米亞拉則向她詢問關於這次任務的事，但女子似乎不太願意透露太多，不過女子表明了自己的名字叫波波，小時候因為名字和機器人系列啵啵相似，被開了很多玩笑，因此不喜歡自己的名字。
波波在馬車前行一段時間後，似乎向兩名清醒的冒險者施放了法術，韓流靠著意志保持清醒，米亞拉則因為天生的特性，不會被影響。米亞拉感到異狀，便也施了法，讓波波必須說實話。

在誠實的波波說明下，兩人得知這次的任務除了烏瑪女王外，似乎有另外的勢力透過波波想做其他事，但重要的資訊卻被干擾了，讓波波無法完整透露。波波表示自己施法只是想讓大家安靜地度過這趟旅程，畢竟這趟旅程要五天才會到，還有很久。經過詢問後，兩人得知波波其實也是機器人。在韓流的要求下，波波將龍之球遞給米亞拉後，開始將自己拆解，直到成為掉落在馬車上的零件。在零件中，有個面板，上面寫著大大的「啵啵OMEGA」，像是商標一樣。
韓流向駕車的啵啵C詢問，得知附近有個村莊。韓流和米亞拉將烏鯊大和穆斯叫醒後，說明剛剛發生的事。四人在村莊停車，找了附近的旅店用餐和住宿，同時也請啵啵C將剛才波波的零件裝在他的肚子內。眾人試著從啵啵C打聽關於剛才波波相關的消息，卻只發現啵啵C是較為初階的機器人，而且他並不知道這件任務背後還有烏瑪女王外的勢力在干預。
啵啵C背後的一個紅色小燈亮起，在他的解釋下，附近有他的夥伴正在接近中。一段時間後，旅店門口的光線被遮蓋住，接著，一名看起來與啵啵C相似的機器人走進了酒館內。啵啵C向大家介紹，這是他的同類啵啵W。啵啵W和他長相相似，只是長得更高，皮膚淺藍色且有紫色斑紋，另外背後長了翅膀。
在啵啵W和啵啵C的說明下，冒險者們決定提早出發到交易點。冒險者將龍之球遞給啵啵W，卻看見他把龍之球放在啵啵C頭上，龍之球融入啵啵C，啵啵C逐漸轉化成與啵啵W相似的模樣，只是稍微小了一點點。進化後的啵啵C自稱自己已變成了啵啵Z。
冒險者們協調著該怎麼「搭乘」啵啵W和啵啵Z。烏鯊大坐上了啵啵W的背，米亞拉則坐上了啵啵Z的背。穆斯和韓流抱起了啵啵W和啵啵Z的大腿，但兩名機器人都表示這樣不平衡，沒辦法飛，穆斯只好改抱啵啵Z的大腿，啵啵W便往外走去。然而，啵啵Z表示這樣太重，他飛不起來，韓流於是決定回到房間去，不管這一切了。在啵啵Z的協調下，穆斯抱著他的兩隻腿，啵啵Z便騰空飛起，跟上已飛在空中的他的前輩。
夜已深，空中的三名冒險者敵不過睡意，米亞拉和烏鯊大都在機器人背上睡著了，穆斯則在迷濛之中，發現自己還抱著啵啵Z的大腿，睡意襲來，他撐不住，便從高空掉了下去。
天亮後，啵啵W和啵啵Z都抵達了約定好的會面點。米亞拉和烏鯊大看見走來的妖精，想向他們說明龍之球溶到機器人身體的事，沒想到一名妖精走向啵啵W和啵啵Z，熟練地在他們機體幾處按了一下，兩顆龍之球便滑順地從他們的身體落了下來，兩名機器人則化回了原本的啵啵V和啵啵C，跟著抱著龍之球的妖精們便往回走，留下詫異的米亞拉和烏鯊大，以及幾箱約定好的美酒。
沒了馬車，美酒無法直接帶走，烏鯊大打開其中一罐酒，大口一飲，這的確比烏瑪女王在晚宴請他們的酒都好喝多了。米亞拉透過法術，向烏瑪女王、留在旅店的韓流，以及不知去向的穆斯傳遞了訊息，告訴他們交易已經完成了，但是沒有馬車，他們回不去。女王表示他會派人過去，但是需要五天的時間才會到；韓流表示既然任務完成了，那他也不用再回去見女王了；穆斯則沒有消息。
五天後，韓流已前往了溫暖的南方，而女王的兩台馬車也到了交易點，馬車上，一台機器人都沒有。

As it had twenty-seven years earlier, the palace banquet hall in Orun, Kingdom of Chryomen, bustled with adventurers. This time, however, the reigning queen at the head table was the former Princess Uma.

For more than two decades, Dragon’s Orb had provided the Kingdom of Chryomen with sustainable electricity. Though the purple markings on the dragon egg had faded, its power remained formidable. The egg now rested in the royal museum, and the queen had hired the adventurers to escort it to a designated trading point. There it would be exchanged with the elven Kingdom of Lawson for several crates of elven wine.

Four adventurers shared the table: Mus, a dark-skinned simian beastfolk; Wu-Sha-Da, a fishfolk who loved playing music and singing; Han-Liu, a half-elf bundled in heavy layers and apparently terrified of cold; and Miara, a dark elf with four spheres of light floating over his head.

Wu-Sha-Da kept the banquet lively. Miara asked Queen Uma about a senior adventurer named Titania, who had reportedly undertaken a mission here and then disappeared. The queen shared what little she knew: Titania had been part of the group sent to retrieve Dragon’s Orb, and only one kobold had returned.

Overhearing Miara’s question, a dwarf approached and claimed to know something, pulling him outside to speak. Wu-Sha-Da and Mus tried to follow but were dismissed at the dwarf’s insistence. Outside a side entrance, the dwarf gave Miara a cigarette, put a hand on his shoulder, and said that twenty-seven years ago he and Titania had shared a wonderful night before her departure. He knew nothing more. As Miara considered this, he saw the dwarf’s hand reach toward a metallic glint at his waist.

The dwarf drew a dagger and repeatedly stabbed Miara in the stomach. Panicking, Miara broke free, fled inside, and used magic to buy time. He stumbled into the banquet hall clutching his wounds, causing an uproar. Queen Uma immediately summoned a doctor. When the attacker returned to the entrance, the queen denounced him. He responded by taking the same dagger, cutting his own throat, and collapsing. The adventurers examined him and found what appeared to be Elvish engraved on the blade, though only the word “Pureblood” could be read. Other dwarves identified the attacker as a blacksmith and said the weapon looked self-forged. No one had ever noticed any sign of his hatred toward elves.

Queen Uma apologized repeatedly and allowed Han-Liu to investigate the dwarf’s smithy. Mus and Wu-Sha-Da stayed with the wounded Miara. At the queen’s arrangement, Wu-Sha-Da shared a room with Miara, while Mus took one bed in a double room and waited for Han-Liu.

Two dwarves accompanied Han-Liu to the smithy. Hoping not to discomfort a fellow person of elven blood, one mentioned that his wife was an elf; the other said he was gay and understood life as a minority. They found the smithy’s door smashed and the interior in disarray. Several daggers resembled the murder weapon, but all were unfinished. They learned little else.

After leaving the smithy, Han-Liu accepted an invitation to spend the night at the home of the dwarf with an elven wife. The other dwarf enthusiastically joined them. The wife could decipher no additional text from the dagger, but the four shared a wonderful night.
In the morning, Mus found that his roommate had not returned. A fully recovered Miara, Wu-Sha-Da—who had slept soundly in the bathtub—and Mus went down to breakfast and waited for Han-Liu.
Midway through the meal, a dwarf woman greeted them and said she would accompany them on the mission. Strangely, she refused to reveal her name.
After breakfast, the woman carried Dragon’s Orb into the carriage with the four adventurers. She introduced their driver, a robot named BoBo-C.

On the road, the woman retrieved beer from the rear compartment for Wu-Sha-Da and Mus. Han-Liu and Miara questioned her about the mission, but she revealed little. She did admit that her name was Bol-Bol. As a child she had been mocked because it sounded like the BoBo line of robots, so she had grown to dislike it.

After the carriage had traveled for some time, Bol-Bol apparently cast a spell on the two adventurers who remained awake. Han-Liu resisted through sheer will, while Miara’s innate nature made him immune. Sensing something wrong, Miara cast a spell of his own that compelled Bol-Bol to tell the truth.

From the now-honest Bol-Bol, they learned that some power besides Queen Uma was using her to pursue another goal through this mission. Interference blocked the crucial details, preventing her from revealing everything. Bol-Bol said she only wanted magic to keep everyone quiet during the five-day journey. Further questioning revealed that she too was a robot. At Han-Liu’s request, Bol-Bol handed Dragon’s Orb to Miara, then dismantled herself piece by piece until only components littered the carriage. Among them was a panel stamped like a trademark with the large words “BoBo-OMEGA.”

Han-Liu asked BoBo-C about the area and learned that a village was nearby. He and Miara woke Wu-Sha-Da and Mus and explained what had happened. The four stopped at the village, found an inn for food and lodging, and asked BoBo-C to store Bol-Bol’s parts inside his abdomen. Their attempts to question him revealed only that BoBo-C was a relatively basic robot and knew nothing about any power interfering with the mission beyond Queen Uma.

A red light illuminated on BoBo-C’s back. He explained that one of his companions was approaching. Some time later, a shadow blocked the inn’s entrance, and a robot resembling BoBo-C stepped inside. BoBo-C introduced his fellow machine, BoBo-W. BoBo-W looked similar but was taller, with pale blue skin, purple markings, and wings.

After hearing from BoBo-W and BoBo-C, the adventurers decided to reach the trading point early. They gave Dragon’s Orb to BoBo-W, who placed it atop BoBo-C’s head. The orb merged into BoBo-C, transforming him into a slightly smaller version of BoBo-W. The evolved BoBo-C announced that he had become BoBo-Z.

The adventurers worked out how to “ride” BoBo-W and BoBo-Z. Wu-Sha-Da sat on BoBo-W’s back and Miara on BoBo-Z’s. Mus and Han-Liu clung to one leg of each robot, but both machines said the imbalance made flight impossible. Mus moved to BoBo-Z’s other leg, and BoBo-W headed outside. BoBo-Z then complained that the load was too heavy to fly, so Han-Liu returned to his room and abandoned the whole affair. At BoBo-Z’s direction, Mus held both his legs, allowing the robot to take off and follow his senior into the sky.

Late that night, the three airborne adventurers succumbed to exhaustion. Miara and Wu-Sha-Da fell asleep on the robots’ backs. Through a haze, Mus realized he was still clinging to BoBo-Z’s legs, but sleep overcame him and he fell from the sky.

By dawn, BoBo-W and BoBo-Z had reached the appointed meeting place. Miara and Wu-Sha-Da saw elves approaching and tried to explain that Dragon’s Orb had merged into the robots. Instead, one elf stepped forward and expertly pressed several points on each machine. Two Dragon’s Orbs slid smoothly from their bodies, restoring the robots to BoBo-V and BoBo-C. The elves walked away carrying the orbs, leaving behind a stunned Miara and Wu-Sha-Da and the promised crates of wine.

Without a carriage, they could not transport the wine. Wu-Sha-Da opened a bottle and drank deeply; it truly was far better than anything Queen Uma had served at the banquet. Miara used magic to message Queen Uma, Han-Liu at the inn, and the missing Mus. The trade was complete, he told them, but they had no carriage home. The queen said she would send someone, though they would take five days to arrive. Han-Liu replied that with the mission complete, he had no need to see the queen again. Mus did not answer.
Five days later, Han-Liu had traveled to the warm south, and two royal carriages reached the trading point. Neither contained a single robot.
